## Migration Notes

- Add the note to the topmost section (upcoming release) with a bold title, usually at the end or next to related notes.
- Keep it short and general: 2 to 5 sentences describing what changed and what projects have to do.
- Link to details (guides, external migration guides, changelogs) instead of repeating them.
- No analysis, background, or lists of affected internals; mention an example only if it clarifies the required action.
- One sentence per line.
